facts.text: IEC 61496 and IEC TS 62998 are neighboring-sector standards for certifying factory safety sensors; ISO 3691-4 covers driverless warehouse trucks, and ISO 18497 covers automated agricultural machines, including obstacle-detection testing.
facts.quote: These are neighboring standards from other sectors: IEC 61496 and IEC TS 62998 certify safety sensors in factories, ISO 3691-4 covers driverless warehouse trucks, and ISO 18497 covers automated farm machines, including how to test their obstacle detection.

facts.text: IEC 61496 is the International Electrotechnical Commission series for electro-sensitive protective equipment, including light curtains and laser scanners; IEC TS 61496-5:2023 covers radar protective devices that stop a factory machine when someone enters a zone.
facts.quote: IEC 61496 is the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) series for electro-sensitive protective equipment: light curtains, laser scanners and, in IEC TS 61496-5:2023, radar protective devices that stop a factory machine when someone enters a zone.

facts.text: IEC 61496 provides an established sensor certification basis, but its radar part states that it does not consider aspects of a moving RPD application.
facts.quote: It gives sensors an established certification basis, but the radar part states that it "does not consider the aspects of a moving RPD application"

facts.text: A vendor's use of IEC TS 62998-1, a technical specification on safety-related sensors, for radar in mobile outdoor use is a vendor claim.
facts.quote: a vendor's use of IEC TS 62998-1 (a technical specification on safety-related sensors) for a radar in mobile outdoor use is a vendor claim.

facts.text: Safety-sensor component certification does not deliver system-level performance on a moving outdoor machine; a certified radar still has to be proved as part of a moving machine in dust and rain.
facts.quote: The sensor standards show the limit of buying certified parts: a certified radar still has to be proved as part of a moving machine in dust and rain [Chapter 1].

facts.text: ISO 3691-4:2023 covers driverless industrial trucks and their systems, and a draft of edition 3 was in progress.
facts.quote: ISO 3691-4:2023 covers driverless industrial trucks and their systems; a draft of edition 3 was in progress

facts.text: No simulation wording was found in ISO 3691-4:2023.
facts.quote: ISO 3691-4:2023 covers driverless industrial trucks and their systems; a draft of edition 3 was in progress and no simulation wording was found [Chapter 12].

facts.text: ISO 18497:2024 is identified as the closest published cousin of the heavy off-road collision mitigation project's function.
facts.quote: ISO 18497:2024 is the closest published cousin of this project's function.

facts.text: ISO 18497 was revised in July 2024 into four parts for partially automated, semi-autonomous and autonomous agricultural machinery, covering design principles, obstacle protection systems, autonomous operating zones, and verification and validation.
facts.quote: Revised in July 2024 into four parts for partially automated, semi-autonomous and autonomous agricultural machinery (design principles, obstacle protection systems, autonomous operating zones, verification and validation)

facts.text: ISO 18497:2024 starts from the premise that no detection technology works perfectly in all conditions and names four failure categories: failure to detect, late detection, incorrect classification and localization error.
facts.quote: it starts from the premise that no detection technology works perfectly in all conditions and names four failure categories: failure to detect, late detection, incorrect classification and localization error [Chapter 2].

facts.text: ISO 18497-4 includes braking, steering, and person or obstacle detection tests, and defines test objects in Annex C.
facts.quote: Part 4 includes braking, steering and person or obstacle detection tests, defines test objects in Annex C

facts.text: ISO 18497-4 lists “Simulation (virtual evaluation of functions and performance)” as a verification method alongside inspection, measurement, test and analysis; the booklet identifies this as the closest off-road standard support found for simulation.
facts.quote: lists "Simulation (virtual evaluation of functions and performance)" among verification methods alongside inspection, measurement, test and analysis, "the closest off-road standard support found" for simulation

facts.text: No evidence was found that ISO 18497-4 authorizes replacing any share of field tests with simulation.
facts.quote: though no evidence was found that it authorizes replacing any share of field tests [Chapters 2, 7, 12].

facts.text: The booklet recommends building the collision mitigation scenario catalog around ISO 21815-3 risk areas and ISO 18497-2's four failure categories.
facts.quote: the booklet suggests building the scenario catalog around ISO 21815-3 risk areas and ISO 18497-2's four failure categories [Chapters 1, 2].
